gloss: at the same time; simultaneously; also

definitions.explanation: Two or more events happening at the same moment or in parallel.

definitions.gloss: at the same time; also; as well
definitions.explanation: Used to add another characteristic or aspect, meaning 'and also' or 'while being.'

examples.japanese: ⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{同時|どうじ}に⟦{立|た}った→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: The two stood up at the same time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{来客|らいきゃく}→来客：13061_raikyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{同時|どうじ}に⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: A phone call and a visitor came at the same time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聴|き}く→聴く：30010_kiku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{同時|どうじ}に⟦{勉強|べんきょう}する→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: It's hard to study and listen to music at the same time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{教師|きょうし}→教師：03029_kyoushi⟧⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{同時|どうじ}に⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: He is a teacher and at the same time a writer.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{同時|どうじ}に⟦{面白|おもしろ}い→面白い：00589_omoshiroi⟧。
examples.english: This problem is difficult and at the same time interesting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{優|やさ}しい⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{同時|どうじ}に⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧⟦{面|めん}→面：09933_men⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: She is kind but at the same time has a strict side too.

notes:
A versatile adverbial expression with two main uses. In its literal sense, it describes simultaneous events. In its connective sense (A⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{同時|どうじ}にB), it links two coexisting qualities or facts about the same subject, similar to English 'while also being.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
- Verb dictionary form + ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{同時|どうじ}に: at the same time as doing
- Noun/adjective + ⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{同時|どうじ}に: while also being

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{同時|どうじ}に: and at the same time
- ⟦{開始|かいし}→開始：02537_kaishi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{同時|どうじ}に: at the same time as the start
- A⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{同時|どうじ}にB: being A while also being B

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{一斉|いっせい}→一斉：01726_issei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: all at once — emphasizes everyone doing something together, not two parallel events
- {併|あわ}せて: together with; at the same time — more formal, often used in written or business contexts
